title: Op tuff script
features:
Visuals & ESP
Player ESP: Boxes, skeletons, tracers, overhead UI, team colors, distance limits.
NPC & Animal ESP: Track bison, bears, gators, and more — even ignore dead ones.
Dropped Items ESP: See ores, gems, and loot with highlight and UI.
Fullbright + No Fog: Light up the whole map.
Remove Water/Grass/Leaves: Clean up the scenery for better visibility.
Custom crosshair & weapon visuals: Change color, material, add tracers.

Movement & Speed
Infinite speed, fly jump, no stamina, no jump cooldown.
Walk on water, swim fast, climb fast, roll like a pro.
Always sprint, no crouch slowdown, no sprint animation.

Combat & Aim
Silent aim with FOV, max distance, hit chance, and bone targeting.
Anti-aim, magic lasso, snap distance — for that extra edge.
Gun mods: No recoil, no spread, instant reload, rapid fire, fast gatling.
Bow mods: Instant draw, no shake, faster aiming.

Horse Stuff
Horse flight, insane speed, boost infinite, no water slowdown.
Auto-accept ride requests, jump boost, spin on command.

Automation & Mining
Auto Mine: Record routes, save, replay, hop after runs, panic exit.
Auto Find: Hunt legendary animals, thunderstruck trees, wanted players.
Loot rules: Keep only what you want — ores, gems, etc.

Trolling & Fun
Spam duel/hug requests — annoy your friends.
Global chat + anonymous mode.

Extras
Staff detection with role alerts.
Cloud/manual configs, share codes, panic exit.
Outfit randomizer, copy, save, load.
